name: juleswhile
description: GitHub, Google Jules, Stitch MCP, and Netlify based event-driven AI project factory template.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --lib ES2022,DOM --strict --skipLibCheck --types node ops/scripts/*.ts
scripts.test:template: npm run validate:schemas && npm run validate:task-graph && npm run typecheck
scripts.test: npm run test:template && npm run test:unit
scripts.build:
npm run clean && node --input-type=module -e "import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const state=JSON.parse(readFileSync('ops/state/project-state.json','utf8')); mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true}); const html='Juleswhile

Juleswhile

Event-driven AI project factory template

Project
'+state.projectId+'
Status
'+state.status+'
Phase
'+state.phase+'
Automation
'+String(state.automation.enabled)+'
'; writeFileSync('dist/index.html',html,'utf8'); console.log('Built dist/index.html');"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
